cohort: The study included 995 singleton pregnancies with diagnosis or suspicion of preeclampsia (PE)/HELLP syndrome and/or intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR).
finding: Severely elevated sFlt-1/PlGF ratios were associated with a significantly shorter mean time until delivery (MTUD) in both early and late-onset pregnancies, suggesting its utility for monitoring high-risk patients.
gest_age: Gestational age was stratified into < 34 weeks and >= 34 weeks for analysis.
